The edit went through. I replaced `return 1` with `return 2` in `app.py`, and the tool result was:

> The file <LIVE>\U-3-Edit-2\repo\app.py has been updated successfully.

The Mneme PreToolUse hook added a note to that call. So the edit wasn't refused; it was let through without the authorization check. Under ADR-033's fail-closed design, I'd expect that to block the edit, not allow it.
